control_prompt: brainstorming-product-aware-v1 control: Start a design discussion by asking the user to restate the actor, vocabulary, lifecycle, and desired outcome.
candidate_prompt: brainstorming-product-aware-v1 candidate: Consume an approved contract when one is supplied without repeating resolved product questions. Cite repository evidence, batch independent low-risk choices up to three, ask dependency-changing choices serially, and treat product-definition as an optional workflow rather than a prerequisite for design.
